title: quickly tender egyptian cranberry tagine
description: a buttery, tender egyptian dish for brunch, featuring cranberry and a dash-friendly shio-koji cure, all in a tasty cazuela

ingredients.name: shio-koji cure
ingredients.notes: see notes for making your own shio-koji cure

instructions: heat the butter in a large cazuela over medium heat.
add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
add the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
add the cranberries and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
add the shio-koji cure and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
add the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
reduce heat to low and cook for 15 minutes, or until the cranberries have broken down and the sauce has thickened.
taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
